# Richard Warsop

Richard Warsop (baptised 21 March 1781) was an English professional cricketer who played in two important matches.
Warsop was from Nottingham and was one of four brothers, Thomas, William and Samuel, all of whom played for Nottingham Cricket Club. He played alongside Thomas for a combined Nottinghamshire and Leicestershire team in a important match in 1803, and made his other appearance for Nottingham itself in 1826 in an important match.
